_note: DERIVED COPY. cots-ratio-reference.md governs; regenerate this file from it. These are documented vendor ratios used by onshape_fetch.py ONLY to attach a LOW-CONFIDENCE candidate to a BOM/part row. Claude does the real resolution against the markdown and the user confirms before any value is trusted. Omitted/uncertain configs live under needsConfirmation and must NOT be guessed.

swerve.<KEY>.aliases: lowercase substrings matched against a part name
swerve.<KEY>.driveRatios: map of config-code -> drive reduction (motor:wheel), dimensionless

planetary.<KEY>.cartridgeStages: available single-cartridge ratios; NET = product of the stacked cartridges

SDS_MK4.source: Swerve Drive Specialties MK4 product page; YAGSL standard conversion factors

SDS_MK4i.source: Swerve Drive Specialties MK4i product page; YAGSL standard conversion factors

REV_MAXSwerve.source: REV MAXSwerve documentation; YAGSL standard conversion factors

REV_MAXPlanetary.netRule: NET ratio = product of the stacked cartridge ratios (e.g. 9:1 + 4:1 cartridges = 36:1). The 9:1 is a first-stage-only cartridge.

VEX_VersaPlanetary.netRule: NET ratio = product of the stacked stage ratios

needsConfirmation._note: Ratios NOT embedded because they are config-heavy or I am not confident of the exact documented value. Do NOT guess these — read the vendor datasheet / ratio table and confirm with the user.

SDS_MK4i_plus.note: L1+/L2+/L3+ use a 16T drive pinion (~14% faster than the 14T base). Read the SDS ratio table; do not reuse the base L1/L2/L3 numbers.

WCP_SwerveX_family.note: WCP Swerve X / X2 / XS: many gear-set x pinion configs. Hand-enter from the WCP product ratio table.

ThriftyBot_Swerve.note: See YAGSL standard conversion factors / ThriftyBot docs.
